name: membership_requests
purpose: Pengajuan join; setiap pengajuan ulang adalah baris baru.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key internal; bukan identifier publik.

columns.name: pending_guard
columns.description: Kolom turunan untuk mencegah pending ganda; jangan ditulis aplikasi.
columns.generated: CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END

checks: (status IN ('approved','rejected') AND reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status NOT IN ('approved','rejected') AND reviewed_by IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL)
(status = 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL)

name: organization_invitations

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key internal; bukan identifier publik.

columns.name: token_hash
columns.type: CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
columns.description: SHA-256 atas token acak; unik. Token minimal 32 byte acak.

columns.name: accepted_by
columns.description: User penerima yang email aktifnya sesuai target.

columns.name: revoked_by
columns.description: Admin pencabut; NULL untuk pencabutan sistem.

columns.name: pending_guard
columns.description: Maksimal satu undangan pending per email per organisasi.
columns.generated: CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END

checks: (status = 'accepted' AND accepted_by IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at < expires_at) OR (status <> 'accepted' AND accepted_by IS NULL AND accepted_at IS NULL)
(status = 'revoked' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'revoked' AND revoked_at IS NULL AND revoked_by IS NULL)

name: borrowings
purpose: Satu request untuk satu aset; approval dan inspeksi return berada pada baris yang sama.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key internal; bukan identifier publik.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Peminjam global; histori tidak bergantung pada membership aktif.

columns.name: borrow_date
columns.description: Tanggal mulai yang diminta dalam kalender Asia/Jakarta.

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: Hari terakhir pengembalian tepat waktu dalam kalender Asia/Jakarta.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Alasan peminjaman, minimal 10 karakter setelah trim.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Status workflow; tidak ada status approved terpisah.

columns.name: approved_by
columns.description: Admin/Staff yang menyetujui sekaligus memulai pinjam.

columns.name: max_borrow_days_snapshot
columns.description: Salinan batas durasi saat approve; immutable setelah approve.

columns.name: late_fine_per_day_snapshot
columns.description: Salinan tarif saat approve; perubahan settings tidak mengubah pinjaman lama.

columns.name: overdue_at
columns.description: Waktu pertama scheduler menandai overdue; dipertahankan setelah return.

columns.name: returned_at
columns.description: Waktu pengembalian fisik; dapat berbeda dari waktu pemrosesan.

columns.name: return_processed_at
columns.description: Waktu petugas menyimpan hasil return; UTC.

columns.name: return_condition
columns.description: Hasil inspeksi satu kali saat return.

columns.name: return_notes
columns.description: Catatan wajib jika hasil bukan good.

columns.name: late_days
columns.description: Hari kalender terlambat saat return; dihitung aplikasi dalam Asia/Jakarta.

columns.name: calculated_fine_amount
columns.description: late_days x snapshot tarif; nilai otomatis sebelum override.

columns.name: fine_amount
columns.description: Denda final yang dicatat; tidak ada pembayaran.

columns.name: fine_override_reason
columns.description: Alasan wajib bila denda final berbeda dari hasil otomatis.

columns.name: active_guard
columns.description: Maksimal satu pinjaman borrowed/overdue per aset.
columns.generated: CASE WHEN status IN ('borrowed','overdue') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END

columns.name: open_user_guard
columns.description: Maksimal satu pending/aktif per user dan aset.
columns.generated: CASE WHEN status IN ('pending','borrowed','overdue') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END

checks: (status IN ('borrowed','overdue','returned') AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND max_borrow_days_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND late_fine_per_day_snapshot IS NOT NULL) OR (status NOT IN ('borrowed','overdue','returned') AND approved_by IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL AND max_borrow_days_snapshot IS NULL AND late_fine_per_day_snapshot IS NULL)
(max_borrow_days_snapshot IS NULL OR max_borrow_days_snapshot >= 1) AND (late_fine_per_day_snapshot IS NULL OR late_fine_per_day_snapshot >= 0)

(status = 'rejected' AND rejected_by IS NOT NULL AND rejected_at IS NOT NULL AND rejection_reason IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(rejection_reason)) > 0) OR (status <> 'rejected' AND rejected_by IS NULL AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejection_reason IS NULL)

(status = 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(cancellation_reason)) > 0) OR (status <> 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NULL)
(status = 'overdue' AND overdue_at IS NOT NULL) OR status = 'returned' OR (status NOT IN ('overdue','returned') AND overdue_at IS NULL)

(status = 'returned' AND returned_at IS NOT NULL AND processed_by IS NOT NULL AND return_processed_at IS NOT NULL AND return_condition IS NOT NULL AND late_days IS NOT NULL AND calculated_fine_amount IS NOT NULL AND fine_amount IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'returned' AND returned_at IS NULL AND processed_by IS NULL AND return_processed_at IS NULL AND return_condition IS NULL AND return_notes IS NULL AND late_days IS NULL AND calculated_fine_amount IS NULL AND fine_amount IS NULL AND fine_override_reason IS NULL)
return_condition IS NULL OR return_condition = 'good' OR (return_notes IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(return_notes)) > 0)
returned_at IS NULL OR (returned_at >= approved_at AND return_processed_at >= returned_at)
(fine_amount IS NULL OR fine_amount >= 0) AND (calculated_fine_amount IS NULL OR calculated_fine_amount >= 0)
calculated_fine_amount IS NULL OR calculated_fine_amount = late_days * late_fine_per_day_snapshot
fine_amount IS NULL OR fine_amount = calculated_fine_amount OR (fine_override_reason IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(fine_override_reason)) > 0)

name: damage_reports
purpose: Laporan kerusakan manual/anggota/inspeksi; sekaligus workflow maintenance MVP.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key internal; bukan identifier publik.

columns.name: borrowing_id
columns.description: Opsional; harus borrowing untuk aset dan organisasi yang sama.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Asal laporan tetap tersimpan walau role pelapor berubah.

columns.name: reported_by
columns.description: Pelapor; untuk hasil inspeksi adalah petugas pemroses return.

columns.name: handled_by
columns.description: Petugas tindakan terakhir; detail pelaku tiap transisi tersimpan di audit.

columns.name: resolution_notes
columns.description: Catatan penyelesaian atau keputusan cukup dicatat.

columns.name: maintenance_guard
columns.description: Maksimal satu maintenance aktif per aset.
columns.generated: CASE WHEN status = 'in_maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END

columns.name: inspection_guard
columns.description: Satu laporan otomatis dari satu inspeksi return.
columns.generated: CASE WHEN source = 'return_inspection' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END

checks: source <> 'return_inspection' OR (borrowing_id IS NOT NULL AND severity IS NOT NULL)
(severity IS NULL AND assessed_at IS NULL) OR (severity IS NOT NULL AND assessed_at IS NOT NULL AND handled_by IS NOT NULL)
status <> 'in_maintenance' OR (maintenance_started_at IS NOT NULL AND severity IS NOT NULL AND handled_by IS NOT NULL)

(status = 'resolved' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_started_at IS NOT NULL AND severity IS NOT NULL AND resolution_notes IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(resolution_notes)) > 0 AND handled_by IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'resolved' AND resolved_at IS NULL)
status <> 'noted' OR (severity IS NOT NULL AND handled_by IS NOT NULL AND resolution_notes IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(resolution_notes)) > 0)
